chunks: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil narrated to us. He said: Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa'd Abadi narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Khalid from Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Najran from Abi Jamila from Jabir b. Yazid al-Ju'fi from Abi Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali al-Baqir from his forefathers (peace be upon them).

He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever conceals a testimony or gives a testimony to shed the blood of a Muslim person or to seize the wealth of a Muslim person will come on the Day of Resurrection with a darkness on his face extending as far as the eye can see, and blemishes on his face. The creatures will know him by his name and lineage. And whoever bears a true testimony to enliven the right of a Muslim person will come on the Day of Resurrection with a light on his face extending as far as the eye can see. The creatures will know him by his name and lineage.
Then Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Do you not see that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, says: "And bear true testimony for Allah."
ai.seo_question: What does Islam say about the consequences of false testimony and concealing evidence on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This prophetic tradition warns of severe consequences on the Day of Resurrection for those who conceal testimony or bear false witness to harm a Muslim's blood or wealth, describing their faces as covered in darkness and blemishes. Conversely, those who bear truthful testimony to uphold a Muslim's rights will have radiant faces. Imam al-Baqir reinforces this by citing Quran 65:2, commanding testimony to be upheld for Allah's sake.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa`d Abadi narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Khalid from `Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Najran from Abi Jamila from Jabir b. Yazid al-Ju`fi from Abi Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali al-Baqir from his forefathers (as).

He said: The Messenger of Allah (s): Whoever conceals a testimony or gives a testimony to shed the blood of a Muslim person or gain the wealth of a Muslim person will come on the Day of Resurrection with a darkness in his face that extends as far as the eye could see. His face will have blemishes. The creatures will know him by name and lineage. Whoever bears a true testimony to enliven the right of a Muslim person, he will come on the Day of Resurrection with a light in his face that extends as far as the eye could see. The creatures will know him by name and lineage.
Then, Abu Ja`far (as) said: Do you not see that Allah says, “And bear true testimony for Allah.” [65:2]
